## About Concrete Pumping Holdings

Concrete Pumping Holdings is the leading provider of concrete pumping services in the highly
fragmented U.S. and U.K. markets, operating under the only established, national brands in both
markets (Brundage-Bone and Camfaud, respectively). Concrete pumping is a "mission-critical" method
of concrete placement that requires highly-skilled operators to position a truck-mounted
fully-articulating boom for precise delivery of ready-mix concrete from mixer trucks to placing
crews on a job site. CPH's large fleet of specialized pumping equipment and highly-trained operators
position CPH to deliver concrete placement solutions that facilitate substantial labor cost savings
to customers, shorten concrete placement times, enhance worksite safety and improve construction
quality. CPH operates a fee-based revenue model with no bonding requirements.

CPH is also the leading provider of concrete waste management services in the U.S. market, operating
under the only established, national brand, Eco-Pan. Highly complementary to its core concrete
pumping service, Eco-Pan provides a full-service, cost-effective, regulatory-compliant solution to
manage environmental issues caused by concrete washout.

As of July 31, 2023, the Company provided concrete pumping services in the U.S. from a footprint of
approximately 100 branch locations across approximately 20 states, concrete pumping services in the
U.K. from approximately 30 branch locations, and route-based concrete waste management services from
19 operating locations in the U.S. and 1 shared location in the U.K.

For more information, please visit [www.concretepumpingholdings.com][18] or the Company’s brand
websites at [www.brundagebone.com,][19] [www.camfaud.co.uk,][20] or [www.eco-pan.com][21].

## About Concrete Pumping Holdings

Concrete Pumping Holdings is the leading provider of concrete pumping services in the highly
fragmented U.S. and U.K. markets, operating under the only established, national brands in both
markets (Brundage-Bone and Camfaud, respectively). Concrete pumping is a "mission-critical" method
of concrete placement that requires highly-skilled operators to position a truck-mounted
fully-articulating boom for precise delivery of ready-mix concrete from mixer trucks to placing
crews on a job site. CPH's large fleet of specialized pumping equipment and highly-trained operators
position CPH to deliver concrete placement solutions that facilitate substantial labor cost savings

end of the 1950s. The Liebherr Group now comprises over 150 companies in more than 50 countries on
every continent.

# In the Philippines – AIMIX Group Construction Machinery Manufacturer

## For the Philippines Market We Provide:

**Warehouse in Sorsogon, Legazpi**, spare parts can be delivered within 12 hours.

**Location Based Service (LBS)** center at the junction of Makati and Pasay, provides efficient and
best service locally.

We have many **local benchmark customers** for these products, like batching plant, self loading
mixer, concrete pump, and brick machine.

machines on-site** possible for customers!

Aimix AJ-120 ready mix concrete batching plant was successfully installed and commissioned in the
Philippines. Aimix has arranged for local engineers to come on-site for after-sales service. After

The customer in the Philippines thought highly of Aimix’s high-quality equipment and considerate
after-sales service. Thanks for the customer’s trust![More info..][13]

The customer in the Philippines decided to buy two different models of self loading mixers for his
rural building construction projects in Bataan, Philippines. One model is AS-3.5, the other model is
AS-5.5.

Self-loading concrete mixer in the Philippines is well-received among customers. it is suitable for
working in remote areas where there is no electric power, such as houses, buildings, country roads,
irrigation, reservoir, mine, rural bridges…… Only one person needed to operate. [More info..][14]


### ABJZ40C Diesel concrete mixer with pump in Davao, Philippines

The Aimix ABJZ40C diesel concrete mixer pump began to be put into use immediately after it
successfully arrived in Davao, Philippines. The main application fields of the mixer pump include
house units, buildings, warehouse, parking area, road construction, and so on…[More info..][15]

* Crushers: Jaw Crusher / Cone Crusher / Impact Crusher

[1964 Allen hardin redimix est]

1968

Bought Allen-Hickson Ready-Mix Plant in Paragould, AR - same location as Allen Mfg. Plant now stands

[1970 Began Con Pumping]
1970

Began concrete pumping operation

1974

Sold all ready-mix and sand/gravel operations in Northeast Arkansas.

[1976]
1976

Dewayne Allen and family moved to Houston, TX. Introduced to screeds

[1977]
1977

Moved back to Paragould, AR - began manufacturing Screed, Fine Graders and Spreaders

[1977]

First World of Concrete Exhibit. Have exhibited in every WOC since. Name changed to Allen
Engineering Corporation

1978

Introduced Power Sprayers.

1979

First international business

Introduced Walk-Behind Trowels

Introduced Roller Tube Finisher

1985

Introduced Aluminum Truss "quick screed"

1987

Introduced first Riding Trowel

1987

Introduced Model 36 Air Screed

1988

Started Promoting Dipsticks for measuring floor flatness

1989

Produced the first Triple roller Tube Pavers

1989

Introduced "flying frame" Riding Trowels

1989

First to place Steel Pans (Floating Discs) under Riding Trowels

1993

Introduced the Magic Screed

[1995]
1995

First Allen Concrete College held in Paragould

1996

Manufactured Model 6036 Bridge Deck Finisher with gang vibration

1996

Introduced "Green" Concrete Saw and Triple Trowel

[1997]
1997

Introduced hydraulic power steering on Riding Trowels

[1999]
1999

Celebrated 35th Anniversary

[1999]
1999

Sold first Slip Form Paver

2000

Introduced hydraulic rotor drive on Riding Trowels

[2003]
2003

Fire destroys majority of AEC factory. Industry rallies in support of company

2005

Operating in new and improved factory by year end

[2007]
2007

Jay Allen becomes AEC President. Dewayne is CEO/Chairman

[2010]
2010

Purchased Miller Power Buggy Line

2011

Received Arkansas Governor's Award for Excellence in Global Trade

2012

Re-branded all products under the Allen brand and red color

2012

Introduced the V.P. (Value Premium) line of walkers

## Construction Equipment And Machinery

Atlas Industries

Our focus is on our customer and the same is shown in our work ethics. We strive to provide superior
and cost effective solutions that will help you stay ahead of your competition.

Civil and road construction equipment are important for the development of infrastructure on a
national level. Buying construction machinery from India has never been easier. With many products
available in different categories, we at Atlas Industries cater to your wide range of **construction
equipment**. Our product list includes equipment from different categories like: asphalt plants,
concrete plants, wet mix plants, bitumen sprayers and road cleaning machines.

In the asphalt plant we manufacture different types and wide range like: batching plants, drum
mixers, counterflow asphalt mixers, mobile asphalt mix plants. We manufacture batch mix plants in
the capacities 80 tph, 120 tph, 160 tph, 200 tph and 260 tph. We make stationary and mobile drum mix
plants in the capacities 40-60 tph, 60-90 tph, 90-120 tph and 120-150 tph. We also manufacture
counterflow asphalt plants in same capacities up to 150 tph. We also have a portable drum mixer of
capacity 20-30 tph. We have exported asphalt plants to **Nepal, Oman, Algeria**, etc.

# Stationary Batching Plants

Conmach stationary concrete batching plants are the ideal solution when ready-made concrete
production and very long-term concrete casting on construction sites are requested. Concrete
capacity of our stationary concrete batching plants a are from 60 m³/h to 175 m³/h.

# Mobile Batching Plants

Conmach mobile concrete batching plants are mostly chosen for the construction base works. Their
advantage is their easy assembling and disasembling features. Concrete capacity of our mobile
concrete batching plants a are from 30 m³/h to 150 m³/h.

# Pioneers in Concrete Machinery and Controls

CM&C Concrete Machinery & Controls has been at the forefront of the concrete machinery industry for
over three decades. We provide global consulting supported by our extensive production experience.
Renowned for our automation expertise, we craft detailed action plans that enhance manufacturing
productivity. Our offerings include essential machinery and control systems, Wenglor Sensors, Fuji
Frenic Drives, and Monitouch HMI. Each solution is tailored to meet the unique needs of our clients,
ensuring efficiency at every step.

2

3

#### Custom Automation, Batching Panels and Control Panels

### About

Designing Buildings is the construction wiki. An industry-wide, cross-discipline forum for finding
and sharing knowledge about the planning, design, construction and operation of built assets.

[[2024 infographic.jpg]][63]

[[Find out more button 350.png]][64]

Designing Buildings has [25 knowledge hubs][65] where you can find introductions to our main subject
areas and links to key articles that will help you learn more

[[Knowledge hubs 350.png]][66]

The site also includes 6 microsites - mini wikis about specialist subjects. Created with our
partners, they provide easy access to curated knowledge about particular aspects of the built
environment:

[[Conservation wiki 350.png]][67]

[[BIM wiki 350.png]][68]

[[People wiki 350.png]][69]

[[AONB wiki 350.png]][70]

[[Building safety wiki button 350.png]][71]

[[Circular economy wiki button.png]][72]

### Get involved

Designing Buildings is a Wiki site - written by its users for its users. We rely on you to add new
content and edit and improve existing content.

You can write about any subject related to the construction industry, including guidance, research,
theories, legislation, news, products and practices. All we ask is that articles are factual (not
adverts) and are encyclopaedic in style (not blog posts).

[[Find out more button 350.png]][73]

[[DBi call to action 350.png]][74]

We're expanding our collaborative mission by launching DB Intelligence, an exclusive market research
advisory panel. Built environment professionals can now get paid to share their expertise on
industry trends, products and services.

Members receive direct financial incentives for participating in research projects like short
surveys, 1-2-1 interviews and focus groups. Participation will be flexible, with opportunities
designed to fit around professional schedules.

This is intended to be practical, relevant and worthwhile: a chance to influence industry thinking
while being rewarded for your time.

If you would like to be considered for the DB Intelligence advisory panel, we would be delighted to
hear from you.

Register today to shape the future of the construction sector.

South Coast Concrete: fibo Collect Self-Service Concrete for Readymix Operators in the UK
South Coast Concrete has become the first dedicated readymix business in the UK and Ireland to
install a fibo Collect machine. The F1200 model for concrete, mortar, and screed offers a new option
of self-service concrete for readymix operators, engineered by fibo intercon and delivered to site
through the fibo Collect UK network. The installation brings the fibo Collect network to 24
confirmed locations across the UK and Ireland, and marks the first time fibo intercon's batching
technology has moved beyond builders' merchants and aggregate yards into a core readymix operation.
][53]

* fibo Collect

Ireland’s first fibo Collect – 18 months in
Ireland’s first fibo Collect installation at Boyles of Tralee is transforming how contractors,
builders and DIY customers access small volumes of concrete, mortar and screed. Just 18 months after
launch, the drive-thru system has become an integral part of the yard – helping customers save time,
reduce waste and collect fresh materials exactly when they need them.
][54]
[
* fibo Collect
* Builders merchant
* United Kingdom
Turnbull Accelerates Growth with a Second fibo Collect
Turnbull Building Supplies is doubling down on its success with fibo Collect, announcing a second
installation—this time in Spalding. The move follows strong performance at their Newark site, where
fast collections, consistent quality, and high customer satisfaction have made the concept a game
changer for local trades. The expansion comes as part of a wider UK rollout, with more than 20 fibo
Collect systems expected to be in operation across the UK and Ireland in 2026. Builders’ merchants
worldwide are seeing the same trend: new revenue streams, reduced waste, and a future-proof business
model built on on-demand concrete production.
][55]

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

[ About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

# OUR HISTORY

## 136 Years
## Strong

In 1890, two brothers—Jesse and Lester Williams—began making their first plastering trowels in their
newly established machine and repair shop. Word of the Williams’ superior tools quickly spread, and
they built a company that would become recognized worldwide as the standard of quality. Although
Jesse and Lester likely never imagined how large MARSHALLTOWN would become, they’d be happy to know
our driving principle remains the same; we offer the BEST products at a FAIR price. [Learn More][36]

## お客様のご要望はどんなことですか？

[原木の選別・皮むきをしたい][37]

原木の径や曲がりに応じた選木や皮むきを行うことによって、次工程機械の高稼働率化が可能になり、トラブル
を減らすことができます。
* [選木機][38]
* [皮剥ぎ機][39]

[製材をしたい][40]

プラントの新設、機械増設等、機械単体の提案はもちろん、工場レイアウトの提案もお任せください。
* [NTBシステム（新型帯鋸製材システム）][41]
* [ツイン帯鋸盤][42]
* [クオードソー][43]
* [ダブルソー][44]
* [ツイン丸鋸盤][45]
* [横型帯鋸盤][46]
* [傾斜帯鋸盤・送材車][47]
* [帯鋸盤][48]
* [送材車][49]
* [ダブルエッジャー][50]

[製材生産のレベルアップをしたい][51]

より良い製材の実現・帯鋸目立て負担の軽減のため、製材サポート室を立ち上げ日々研究しています。
* [帯鋸用自動ロール機][52]
* [もっと知りたい帯鋸の話][53]

[木材を乾燥させたい][54]

高温・中温乾燥機のほか、平角材のより良い乾燥や、乾燥時間の短縮・木材の熱劣化抑制に抜群の効果がある減
圧乾燥機まで豊富に取り揃えています。
* [木材乾燥機各種][55]
* [なるほど！乾燥の話][56]

[木材以外の素材を切断したい][57]

樹脂、コンクリートパネル、段ボール等、木材以外の切削に関してもお気軽にご相談ください。

## About Quadra South Africa — Precast Concrete Machinery Experts

Quadra South Africa specialises in supplying advanced precast concrete brick, block and paving
machinery, tailored to the needs of the South African market. With over 30 years of global
engineering expertise from Quadra Concrete Equipment France, we empower concrete producers with
efficient, reliable, and automated concrete block, brick, and paving block manufacturing solutions.


Our mission is to support the growth of the South African precast concrete sector by offering
machinery that helps manufacturers meet SANS quality standards, increase throughput, and optimise
production workflows. Operating across all nine provinces in South Africa and backed by local
technical support, we combine global innovation with local industry insight.

[Read More About Quadra South Africa here!][15]

## Quadra Machinery Available to the South African Concrete Brick, Block and Paving Manufacturers

### Quadra Q5E  - Vibrating Press

Ideal for smaller to medium precast concrete operations.

### Quadra Q6F - Vibrating Press

Mid-range vibrating press for increased capacity.

[Find out more about Quadra Concrete Equipment here!][16]

### Quadra Q12HP Vibrating Press

Top-tier solution for high-volume production.

Our range of vibrating press machines is engineered to deliver consistent quality, high output, and
automation for concrete block and brick production. From small to medium to high-performance
presses, Quadra machinery ensures fast cycle times, precise compaction, and superior surface finish
— helping producers stay competitive and compliant with industry standards.


Our specialised solutions for concrete block paving production help manufacturers achieve SANS 1058
compliance with high-density, durable, and consistently produced paving units. Quadra systems
integrate patented precision vibration technology, automated handling, and efficient workflow
design, enabling producers to maximise output while reducing labour costs and waste.

## Our Partners

Quadra South Africa collaborates with industry-leading partners to offer complete precast plant
solutions — including batching plants, mixers, curing systems, moulds, and production pallets. These
partnerships enhance capabilities across the full production cycle, from raw material handling to
finished product.

## Buy a Mobile Batching Plant From the Company that Invented It

In 1956, Mr. Vince Hagan, founder of The Vince Hagan Company, started with an original idea: he
would design, build, and patent **(U.S. patent #3,251,484)** the very first fully mobile concrete
batch plant.

Over the years, his “Haganator,” a heavy-duty truss design, became an industry icon. Today, it
includes in-truss dust collection, the largest aggregate capacity, and many operator-friendly
upgrades.

Vince Hagan invented the mobile batch plant in 1956 • Patented in 1966 – US 3,251,484

[Vince Hagan invented the Mobile Concrete Batch Plant in 1956]

### Increase Profits & Productivity withService & Training Worldwide

The Vince Hagan Service Team is the best in the industry, and we’re not bragging there – it’s a
fact. With over 100 years of combined experience, our [batching equipment service and optimization
team][97] can help you develop a maintenance and improvement plan to maximize your equipment’s
productivity and increasing your profits. We can meet you anywhere in the world, or help you
troubleshoot your equipment from our headquarters in Dallas, Texas through the SmartVH™ Plant
Monitoring System.

[Get a Batch Plant Service Quote][98]

### No More Cranes Needed with Self Erecting Batch Plants

We introduced the most user-friendly and [mobile self erecting batch plants][99] on the market. Our
industry-first safety control feature that ensures level hydraulic raising and lowering of the
plant. The plant comes standard with a Vince Hagan exclusive in-truss dust collection system.
Meaning a true “one load” for both mobile batch plant and dust control unit that does not require
the use of cranes to erect. No longer does your company have crane costs, extra load costs and labor
costs for plant erection.

[Self Erecting Batching Equipment][100]
[SmartVH Plant Monitoring System]

### SmartVH^{™} Plant Monitoring System Reduce Plant Downtime & Maintenance Problems

The new SmartVH™ Plant Monitoring System utilizes Bluetooth and an array of sensors placed on major
mechanical components to monitor, log data, and issue alerts in real-time via a mobile app (on
Android & Apple devices). These sensors alert your plant manager when maintenance or repairs are
required based on operating trends. This mitigates plant downtime, and reduces maintenance costs.
In-app reminders simplify the supervision of scheduled maintenance tasks for plant managers.
